intro.text: Brightness Litima, a lighteyed Alethi woman and scribe in Dalinar's warcamp on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Litima read passages from The Way of Kings to Dalinar in his quarters. She was there when a spanreed message arrived from Jasnah, but let the newly arrived Danlan read it and reply.

appearance.text: Tall and plump, she wears a violet havah with yellow trim.
